name: Greek Mythology Chthonic Deities
title: Greek Mythology Chthonic Deities
description: 35 chthonic (underworld) deities from Greek mythology including Hades, Persephone, and Hecate, with their Greek names, Roman equivalents, and descriptions.

rows.name: Amphiaraus
rows.description: a hero of the war of the Seven Against Thebes who became an oracular spirit of the Underworld after his death

rows.name: Angelos
rows.description: a daughter of Zeus and Hera who became an underworld goddess

rows.name: Askalaphos
rows.description: the son of Acheron and Orphne who tended the Underworld orchards before being transformed into a screech owl by Demeter

rows.name: Cerberus
rows.description: the three-headed hound who guarded the gates of Hades

rows.name: Charon
rows.description: ferryman of Hades

rows.name: Empusa
rows.description: a monstrous underworld spirit or spirits with flaming hair, the leg of a goat and a leg of bronze. They are also servants of Hecate.

rows.name: Erebos
rows.description: the primeval god of darkness, his mists encircled the underworld and filled the hollows of the earth

rows.name: Erinyes
rows.description: the Furies, goddesses of retribution, known as "The Kindly Ones"

rows.name: Alecto
rows.description: the unceasing one

rows.name: Tisiphone
rows.description: avenger of murder

rows.name: Megaera
rows.description: the jealous one

rows.name: Hecate
rows.description: goddess of magic, witchcraft, the night, moon, ghosts, and necromancy

rows.name: Aiakos
rows.description: Judges of the Dead - former mortal king of Aegina, guardian of the keys of Hades and judge of the men of Europe

rows.name: Minos
rows.description: Judges of the Dead - former mortal king of Crete and judge of the final vote

rows.name: Rhadamanthys
rows.description: Judges of the Dead - former mortal lawmaker and judge of the men of Asia

rows.name: Keuthonymos
rows.description: an Underworld spirit and father of Menoetes

rows.name: Cronus
rows.description: deposed king of the Titans; after his release from Tartarus he was appointed king of the Island of the Blessed

rows.name: Lamia
rows.description: a vampiric Underworld spirit or spirits in the train of Hecate

rows.name: Lampades
rows.description: torch-bearing Underworld nymphs

rows.name: Orphne
rows.description: a Lampad nymph of Hades, mother of Askalaphos

rows.name: Macaria
rows.description: daughter of Hades and goddess of blessed death (not to be confused with the daughter of Heracles

rows.name: Melinoe
rows.description: daughter of Persephone and Zeus who presided over the propitiations offered to the ghosts of the dead

rows.name: Menoetes
rows.description: an Underworld spirit who herded the cattle of Hades

rows.name: Mormo
rows.description: a fearsome Underworld spirit or spirits in the train of Hecate

rows.name: Nyx
rows.description: the primeval goddess of night

rows.name: Hades
rows.description: God of underworld and all things beneath the earth

rows.name: Persephone
rows.description: queen of the underworld, wife of Hades and goddess of spring growth

rows.name: Acheron
rows.description: Rivers of the Underworld - the river of woe

rows.name: Kokytos
rows.description: Rivers of the Underworld - the river of wailing

rows.name: Lethe
rows.description: Rivers of the Underworld - the river of forgetfulness

rows.name: Phlegethon
rows.description: Rivers of the Underworld - the river of fire

rows.name: Styx
rows.description: Rivers of the Underworld - the river of hatred and oaths

rows.name: Tartarus
rows.description: Rivers of the Underworld - the primeval god of the dark, stormy pit of Hades

rows.name: Thanatos
rows.description: Rivers of the Underworld - spirit of death and minister of Hades
